config.secondary-language.name: Secondary Language
config.secondary-language.description: Language code for secondary display names (e.g. default, en, vi, es, fr, ja, ko, zh). 'default' uses base unlocalized content, 'en' explicitly uses English.
config.show-secondary.name: Show Secondary Name
config.show-secondary.description: Whether to display the secondary language name in item tooltips and expanded UI.
config.show-secondary-dialogue.name: Show Secondary Dialogue (Preview)
config.show-secondary-dialogue.descripti: Show a smaller translation for eligible NPC dialogue. Both languages can wrap when the pair fits in the box.
config.secondary-first.name: Secondary Text First
config.secondary-first.description: Display secondary names and dialogue above the primary text.
config.diacritic-insensitive.name: Diacritic-Insensitive Search
config.diacritic-insensitive.description: Ignore diacritics and normalize characters like đ/Đ during search matching.
log.mod-loaded: Untranslated Stardew loaded successfully. Secondary language: {{language}}.
log.secondary-fallback: Secondary language '{{language}}' has no usable custom source. Display mode: {{fallback}}.
log.missing-glyph: Glyph '{{glyph}}' (U+{{codepoint}}) from '{{source}}' is not supported in active fonts for language '{{language}}'.
log.missing-font: Secondary {{fontKind}} font asset '{{asset}}' for locale '{{language}}' is unavailable. Falling back to primary font.{{detail}}
log.source-missing: Language source '{{language}}' is not registered or has no content root.
